fields.Name: T344 - Labels List View Column Sort
fields.Description: Exercises the component's own OnSortChange/sortLabels/GetSortIcon sorting over the in-memory list (custom sortable headers), not the generic AG-grid column sort.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Version History app → Labels surface, switch to list view, then click a sortable column header such as 'Name' or 'Created'. Confirm a sort direction indicator (arrow) appears on that column and clicking the same header again toggles the direction. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. If multiple labels exist the row order should change; seeing the sort indicator respond is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: In list view the column headers (Name/Status/Items/Created) are clickable
Clicking a header shows a sort direction indicator and (if multiple labels exist) reorders rows
Clicking the same header again toggles the sort direction indicator
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
